links.outcome: Errors in LLM-generated radiology reports, by error type and model
links.effect: Errors occurred in LLM-generated reports, with template-related errors most common and no significant difference across models (χ2 = 1.146, p = 0.564). Authors conclude human oversight is needed.
links.quote: However, there remains a need for human oversight to address errors in the generated reports.

unlisted_practices: Summary-based radiologist reporting with LLM expansion into institution-specific templates to reduce reporting time

screen.reason: Empirically tests an LLM workflow intervention (generating structured reports from radiologist-provided summaries) compared against conventional reporting to assess reporting time and error rates.
